questions.answer: Emails for incoming student

questions.answer: Quite hard, it is a small uni and there is not a lot of classes that arent in the same timeblock, so you dont have much options

questions.answer: Try to apply for classes as early as possible, since you can end up on waiting list if your not quick

questions.answer: surf community is nice

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *

questions.answer: Some exams are harder than others, so focus your effort on macro in particular since the exam is very different from what we are used to
